name: Landis
source:
Though somewhat introverted and timid, he is kind at heart.
The Dragon Prince of Granda.
When Granda Castle was attacked, the Dragon King Distal entrusted him with the will to defeat Lengalt and sent him to safety in a remote land.
Unable to accept his destiny, however, he spent the next three years living in hiding.
